description: Automated Enforcement Loop: when the customer's sealed decisions cross a threshold, sebbi.pro acts at once. It contains the AI (every further decision on the key is a sealed BLOCK, so the sebbi.pro Gateway stops calling the model), pulls their Jugular switches, fires a signed webhook into their own infrastructure, and emails them. Every trip and release is sealed. trigger: {count, window_seconds, verdicts ([BLOCK, CHALLENGE, ALLOW]), reasons_any (words to find in the decision's reasons, e.g. prompt_injection or a risk signal name), min_score, field {field, op (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, not_in, contains, exists), value}, distinct_field (count different values of this field, e.g. model)}. actions: {contain_minutes (-1 = until released, 0 = no), jugular_ids, webhook_url (https), email_owner}. mode: armed or watch. Run sebbi_enforce_backtest first.
name: sebbi_enforce_create
title: Arm an enforcement loop
